## SBA Loans in Hawaii

Hawaii businesses received **$53.4M** in [SBA 7(a) loan](https://gosbaloans.com/guide/the-ultimate-guide-to-sba-7-a-loans-in-2026-requirements-rates-and-how-to-qualify/) approvals across **231 businesses** in 2025, supporting **1,761 jobs**. With **29 active SBA lenders** competing for business in Hawaii, comparing offers is essential — rates vary significantly by lender.

The average SBA loan in Hawaii is **$231K** at **10.92%**, which is **0.6% above** the national average of 10.32%. The top lender in Hawaii is **[Newtek Bank](https://gosbaloans.com/ranking/newtek-bank/), National Association**, with the most-funded industry being **Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists)**.

**GoSBA Analysis:** Hawaii has 29 active SBA lenders, meaning plenty of competition for your deal. Working with a broker like [GoSBA Loans](https://gosbaloans.com/apply/) lets you access multiple Hawaii-active lenders with one application — better rates, faster approvals, zero cost.

## SBA Loans in Hawaii by Business Type

Whether you’re starting a business, buying one, or expanding an existing operation in Hawaii, here’s how SBA lending breaks down:

🚀 Startup10%$5.6M · 15 loans

🤝 Business Acquisition16%$8.5M · 10 loans

🏢 Existing Business62%$33.2M · 139 loans

💼 New Business (≤2 yrs)11%$6.1M · 67 loans

**Startups** represent 10% of Hawaii SBA loans (15 loans totaling $5.6M). **Business acquisitions** (change of ownership) account for 16% (10 loans, $8.5M). **Existing businesses** make up the largest share at 62% (139 loans). If you’re [buying a business](https://gosbaloans.com/guide/how-to-buy-a-business-with-sba-loan/) in Hawaii, acquisitions are a well-established use case for SBA 7(a) loans.
